weather_report:
Subiaco dozes under a quiet pre-dawn, the air still and cool, with a promise of clear sky toward first light before a light, passing rain drifts in later in the morning. Expect a few honest bursts of sunshine early, then a softer, pearl-gray day as clouds gather; the UV will be low at first and only modest if the sun breaks through, more a gentle nudge than a warning. The view should start crisp, then grow slightly veiled as dampness polishes the streets and rounds the edges of the day.

It looks like a calm, workable Friday rather than a dazzling one. Dress in light layers with a compact rain shell, comfortable shoes that don’t mind a wet footpath, and keep sunscreen minimal in your pocket for any brighter spells; a hat feels optional. If you’re awake with the birds, a short, unhurried walk or a quick grocery run suits the clear start, then lean into indoor errands, a quiet hour at a cafe window, or a tidy-up of lingering tasks while the shower passes. Later, if the clouds lift, steal a small afternoon circuit of the neighborhood and enjoy the scent of rain cooling the brick and jacaranda.
